title: Private & Cozy Green Hills Loft ~ 15 mins Downtown
description:
Located in the prestigious and tranquil Green Hills neighborhood of Nashville, our cozy guesthouse provides easy & convenient access to all the hotspots downtown as well as the surrounding areas in a calm and peaceful setting.

-PRIVATE - completely detached from the main residence
-Free parking (garage)
-Cozy, warm design w/ full kitchen 
-King bed w/ comfy linens
-Belmont, Lipscomb and Vanderbilt ~ 10 mins
-Shopping, restaurants and Bluebird cafe ~ 5 mins 
-Local Superhost w/ 300+ 5 ★ reviews!

The space
Bedroom:

- King bed w/ with premium bedding
- Spacious closet and dresser for belongings 

Living Room: 

 - Pull-out sofa bed with bedding provided
- 55" Smart TV to login into your Netflix, Hulu, Amazon accounts

Kitchen:

- Fully equipped kitchen (cookware, utensils, plates, glasses, etc.)
- Dishwasher
- Keurig Coffee makes w/ complimentary k-cups 
- Small dining table to accomodate four 

Bathroom:

- Shower with soaking tub 
- Complimentary shampoo, conditioner, body wash 
- Hair dryer
- Wash, hand & bath towels provided

Notable Amenities:

- 24 hour keyless access with personal key code
- Fast and reliable wireless high speed internet with ethernet
- In-unit washer/dryer with complimentary detergent
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Complimentary coffee
- Private garage parking

Guest access
FREE PARKING (garage) 

Keypad entry with deadbolt for easy access and safety - no keys necessary

Other things to note
Sorry, no pets allowed 
No smoking inside 
Please do not disturb tenants in the main residence
